name: requirements-synthesizer
description: Consolidate requirements from multiple stakeholders into one complete, traceable requirements specification delivered as a PDF. Takes meeting transcripts (txt, vtt, srt), spreadsheets (xlsx, xls, csv), Word documents, PDFs, slides and emails as input, extracts and de-duplicates requirements, attributes each to its stakeholders and sources, flags conflicts and gaps, and produces a professional PDF (SRS / BRD style).
